# The Inclusion Edit

> The Inclusion Edit is an award-winning inclusion consultancy (Best EDI Consultancy, Corporate Vision HR and Employment Awards 2026) and the home of the Impact Platform: practical tools, learning, evidence and expert support for the person carrying inclusion in their organisation, often alone and alongside the day job. We work with corporate teams, public bodies, charities and schools worldwide. Founded by Rebekah Hayward. Tagline: Capacity. Capability. Change.

## The Impact Platform

An online inclusion learning and development platform, launching in January 2027. Members join in small groups from the early access list.

- 40 lessons across three pathways: People and Culture, Systems and Processes, Leadership and Strategy
- 45 practical tools: templates, toolkits, guides and checklists
- 47 research reports and case studies to take to leadership
- 28 expert videos: Masterclasses, Skills Sessions and Quick Takes
- 10 Inclusion AI tools, for example policy audits, business cases and fairer hiring
- The Inclusion Editors community, where members ask questions and share what works
- Office hours with an inclusion expert on organisation memberships

## Memberships and prices (no VAT is added)

For individuals:
- Individual: £345 a year, or £34 a month
- Practitioner Plus: £495 a year, or £49 a month. Adds the Inclusion AI tools, a full inclusion health check and action plan, and advanced resources
- The Expert Track: £1,800 a year. Adds a monthly 1:1 with Rebekah Hayward all year. Limited places

For organisations (chosen by the number of people who will use it, not organisation size; every seat has Practitioner Plus access):
- Small Teams: £1,750 a year, 5 full seats, onboarding for up to 25 new starters a year
- Growing Teams: £2,950 a year, 10 full seats, onboarding for up to 50 new starters a year
- Established Teams: £5,500 a year, 25 full seats, onboarding for up to 200 new starters a year
- Enterprise: from £8,500 a year, 50 or more seats, unlimited new starter onboarding

Early access members keep their price for their first two renewals.

## Services

- [Inclusion Consultancy](https://theinclusionedit.com/edi-consultancy-programmes): audits, strategy, policy reviews and programmes
- [Inclusion Training](https://theinclusionedit.com/edi-training): workshops and programmes for teams, managers and leaders
- [Bespoke Inclusion Resources](https://theinclusionedit.com/bespoke-inclusion-resources): toolkits, guides and e-learning made for an organisation
